attchmntText: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited published an advertisement on 14th November 2026 regarding its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended 30th September 2026. The company reported Total Income from operations of 9,647.59 lacs for the quarter ended 30th September 2026, compared to 7,953.23 lacs in the previous year. Net Profit after tax for the quarter was 53.02 lacs, versus a loss of 312.43 lacs in the corresponding period last year. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, Total Income was 18,796.57 lacs, and Net Profit after tax was 101.23 lacs. Earnings Per Share for the quarter was 1.35 rupees. The paid-up Equity Share Capital remains 393.46 lacs with a face value of 10 rupees each. The results were signed by Managing Director Krishna Mahesh on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of Unaudited Standalone financial results of the company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditors issued a Limited Review Report with an Unmodified Opinion. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 was Rs. 9,604.84 lacs. Profit for the period was Rs. 53.02 lacs. Earnings Per Share was Rs. 1.35. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, Revenue from operations was Rs. 18,702.57 lacs. Profit for the period was Rs. 101.23 lacs. Earnings Per Share was Rs. 2.57. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 stood at Rs. 21,612.36 lacs. The meeting commenced at 10.05 AM and concluded at 12.05 PM.
